OnlineDirectory.methods._resolve:
extends OnlineDirectory

# Set this to the backend lookup for this directory's listings.
var find_route: Callable

func _resolve(listing_id: String, request: OnlineDirectoryRequest) -> void:
    if not find_route.is_valid():
        request.fail()
        return
    var endpoint: SessionEndpoint = find_route.call(listing_id) as SessionEndpoint
    if endpoint == null:
        request.fail()
        return
    request.resolve(endpoint)
SaveCoordinator.methods.request_save:
const PLAYER_PROFILE: String = "player-1"
const CAMPAIGN_SLOT: String = "campaign"

func queue_manual_save(saves: SaveCoordinator) -> int:
    var ticket: int = saves.request_save(PLAYER_PROFILE, CAMPAIGN_SLOT, {"label": "Harbor"})
    # After the next authoritative commit, capture with capture_pending().
    # Observe operation_finished and match its ticket before reporting success.
    return ticket
SessionAuthenticator.methods._verify:
extends SessionAuthenticator

# The verifier checks the provider, challenge, and session context, then returns a verified identity.
var verify_identity: Callable

func _verify(request: SessionAuthRequest) -> void:
    if not verify_identity.is_valid():
        request.reject()
        return
    var identity: SessionIdentity = verify_identity.call(request) as SessionIdentity
    if identity == null:
        request.reject()
        return
    request.accept(identity)
SteamCommerceBackend.methods._begin:
extends SteamCommerceBackend

# Send the checkout to your authenticated game backend. It prices the cart
# and returns a typed result that echoes this checkout ID.
var begin_checkout: Callable

func _begin(cart: SteamPurchaseCart, checkout_id: String, request: SteamCommerceRequest) -> void:
    var result: SteamPurchaseOutcomeResult
    if begin_checkout.is_valid():
        result = await begin_checkout.call(cart, checkout_id) as SteamPurchaseOutcomeResult
    if result == null:
        result = SteamPurchaseOutcomeResult.create(ERR_UNAVAILABLE, null, checkout_id)
    request.complete_order(result)

SteamProvider.methods.configure:
extends Node

# Use the Spacewar test AppID while learning. Replace it with your own AppID.
const STEAM_APP_ID: int = 480
const LOBBY_NAMESPACE: String = "crimson-harbor"
const TOTAL_SEATS: int = 2

# The world needs at least two player spawn points for this capacity.
@export var game_definition: GameDefinition

var _game: GameRuntime

# Connect the Host button to this method.
# configure() defaults to a private lobby. Send invites after hosting succeeds.
func host_invite_only_game() -> void:
    if is_instance_valid(_game):
        return
    if game_definition == null:
        push_error("Assign a game definition with the world and player scenes.")
        return

    var provider: SteamProvider = SteamProvider.configure()
    provider.set_app_id(STEAM_APP_ID)
    provider.set_lobby_namespace(LOBBY_NAMESPACE)
    if provider == null:
        push_error("The Steam settings are invalid.")
        return

    var rules: MultiplayerRules = MultiplayerRules.listen_coop().with_max_players(TOTAL_SEATS)
    _game = game_definition.with_provider(provider).with_multiplayer(rules).boot(self)
    if _game == null:
        push_error("Could not attach the game runtime.")
        return

    var hosted: Dictionary = await _game.host_online().wait()
    if not hosted.ok:
        push_error(hosted.message)
        _game.queue_free()
        _game = null
        return
    print("Invite-only lobby ready: ", _game.get_online_listing())
SteamProvider.methods.dedicated:
extends Node

# Set the AppID and product metadata for the Steam title you administer.
const STEAM_APP_ID: int = 480
const SERVER_NAME: String = "Harbor Training Server"
const GAME_PORT: int = 27015
const QUERY_PORT: int = 27016
const LOBBY_NAMESPACE: String = "crimson-harbor-dedicated"
const TOTAL_SEATS: int = 2
const PRODUCT_VERSION: String = "1.0.0.0"
const PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION: String = "Spacewar"
const PRODUCT_DIRECTORY: String = "Spacewar"

# The world needs at least two player spawn points for this capacity.
@export var game_definition: GameDefinition

# Attach this script to the root of the dedicated process's scene.
func _ready() -> void:
    if game_definition == null:
        push_error("Assign the required dedicated server settings in the Inspector.")
        return

    var settings: SteamServer = SteamServer.configure(SERVER_NAME, GAME_PORT, QUERY_PORT)
    settings = settings.with_product_metadata(PRODUCT_VERSION, PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION, PRODUCT_DIRECTORY)
    var provider: SteamProvider = SteamProvider.configure().for_app(STEAM_APP_ID)
    provider = provider.with_lobby_namespace(LOBBY_NAMESPACE)
    # This branch opens a SteamGameServer session for the playerless world.
    provider = provider.dedicated(settings)
    var rules: MultiplayerRules = MultiplayerRules.listen_coop().with_max_players(TOTAL_SEATS)
    var game: GameRuntime = game_definition.with_provider(provider).with_multiplayer(rules).boot(self)
    if game == null:
        push_error("Could not attach the dedicated runtime.")
        return

    var started: Dictionary = await game.start_dedicated_online().wait()
    if not started.ok:
        push_error(started.message)
        return
    print("Dedicated server locator: ", game.get_online_listing())
